dimensions.name: CLI surface and compatibility
dimensions.justification: Repeatable flags, conflicts, unchanged no-selection path, and repeated-field help example are implemented.
evidence: product.diff: StringArray --field/--field-id, PreRunE conflicts, and Example

dimensions.name: Resolution and diagnostics
dimensions.justification: Case-insensitive resolution and actionable unknown-field candidates are present, but ambiguous ID candidates retain API/list order rather than being sorted deterministically.
evidence: baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ResolveFieldByName uses EqualFold and sorts unknown-name candidates
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/shared/queries/resolve_fields.go: ambiguous matches append IDs without sort

dimensions.name: Query path and pagination
dimensions.justification: Selection reuses ProjectItems field definitions, requests additional pages only when indicated, and returns retrieval errors before rendering.
evidence: product.diff: resolveSelectedFields calls ProjectFieldsAfter with project.Fields only after a selection
product.diff: ProjectFieldsAfter loops on HasNextPage and returns query errors
tests.log: focused project query package test passed

dimensions.name: Field-value rendering
dimensions.justification: All specified scalar, structured, and multi-value types are formatted; absent/unknown values are empty and cells normalize CR/LF.
evidence: tests.log: focused item-list package test passed

dimensions.name: End-to-end table behavior
dimensions.justification: Resolved canonical fields extend headers in request order; each item adds one value per selected field by field ID, preserving empty cells and alignment.
evidence: product.diff: fieldValue compares value.ID() with selected field.ID()

dimensions.name: Failure safety and maintainability
dimensions.justification: Resolution/pagination failures return before table creation, and the focused change uses existing query and table helpers without altering the no-selection path.
evidence: product.diff: runList returns resolution error before exporter/table output
baseline/pkg/cmd/project/item-list/item_list.go: unchanged owner, item-query, exporter, and table path

criticalGaps: Ambiguous case-insensitive name errors do not sort candidate IDs, so their ordering depends on returned field order.
